verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents an API reference (webhooks, push APIs, framework-health/vendor-data APIs) but no evidence of official client SDKs (e.g., Python/JS/Go libraries); an openapi.json probe returned 404s across all standard paths, and the GitHub 'compliance-skills' repo is an agent-skill package, not an SDK. missing for 10: published SDK packages, language-specific client libraries, OpenAPI/spec discoverability.
